review.notes: Accepted with corrections applied in place. Coverage: all 158 retained plan targets present one-to-one, every definition with at least three Checks and its full API; the two removed targets cited from their owners. Duplication fixed: the generalized elliptic curve, standard polygons, n-gon Tate family and fine moduli schemes are now imported from AdicSpacesPartIII R2.11 (sections 2.1, 2.2, 3.6 rewritten as results on those carriers, sections 2.8 and 3.5 state agreement on their range); lattice uniformization and the genus-one family over the upper half-plane are cited from AbelianSchemesAndArithmeticModuli A5.1 and A5.8; analytic cusp data and ramification from FuchsianOrbifolds Layers 3-4; the analytic Fricke map is Tau Ceti frickeGL (README and Lean). Supplier contracts that the named suppliers do not state were closed: new Layer 0 targets for the Abramovich-Vistoli local structure of Deligne-Mumford stacks with wild inertia (0.1) and Serre's pseudo-reflection criterion (0.2, with a light Lean definition IsPseudoReflection); the relative Jacobian norm and polarization (13.1), the Kummer comparison (13.5), the quotient by an abelian subvariety (16.2) and connected components under separably closed extension (4.9) are now owned targets; stack cohomology, the coherent trace, Grothendieck algebraization, the Artin comparison and SL2 reduction surjectivity point to SF.2, SF.4, TauCetiRoadmap CohomologicalPointCounting and Tau Ceti declarations that state them; the nonexistent R07.1 and AdicSpacesPartII F0 citations were removed. Missing supplier sections added (AdicSpacesPartIII, ComplexComparisonPartII, LefschetzPencilsAndVanishingCycles, ArithmeticGaloisRepresentations, CohomologicalPointCounting). Process residue removed: request wording, packet ids and downstream stage ids, 70 packet-slug cross-references turned into section links, anchor-slug link labels, theorem interfaces that repeated their statement. Sources: more than 30 locators in 15 public sources read (Conrad, Cesnavicius, BDMTV, Ribet-Stein, Zywina, Masser-Zannier, Gross-Zagier, CDT, Calegari-Geraghty, Edixhoven, Abramovich-Vistoli, Conrad Keel-Mori, Stacks 0363); all confirmed, including the package's corrections of Conrad Thm 4.3.4 indexing, Cesnavicius Prop 4.3.6 at n=1, Gross-Zagier III (1.4) and CDT Lemma 4.5.11. Adversarial pass recorded in the report (degenerate levels, characteristic 2 and 3, sign conventions). lean-check of the final Suggested.lean (430 lines): exit 0, only sorry warnings (32). Maintainer notes: same-tier overlap with ArithmeticLocallySymmetricSpaces ALS.3.14 and ALS.0.10 (sections 15.8, 17.8); imports from open upstream pull requests #813 and #196; downstream requests (Kuga-Sato fibre powers for GeneralizedHeegnerCycles) not in this plan.
